title: Rename HTMLOrSVGElement to reflect its wider use in MathML as well

labels.name: impacts documentation
labels.description: Used by documentation communities, such as MDN, to track changes that impact documentation

body:
<!--
Thank you for contributing to the HTML Standard! Please describe the change you are making and complete the checklist below if your change is not editorial.
-->
(updated tests)

Renames relatively recent `HTMLOrSVGElement` IDL mixin to `HTMLOrForeignElement` in order to reflect its wider use in MathML as well, which previously was just `Element`.  This is referenced in the new interface defined in [MathML-Core](https://mathml-refresh.github.io/mathml-core/) and aimed at resolving this historical oddity.

- [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed):
  * new MathMLElement which uses this mixin is shipping in Firefox already
  * new MathMLElement patches landed in webkit on 9/6/2019
  * supportive comments from blink owner in https://github.com/mathml-refresh/mathml/issues/83, upstreaming in https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=6606#c89
- [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at:
  * https://wpt.fyi/results/mathml/relations/html5-tree/html-or-foreign-element-interfaces.tentative.html?label=master&label=experimental
  * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/mathml/relations/html5-tree/tabindex-002.html

- [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/master/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed:
   * Chrome: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=835571
   * Firefox: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1571487
   * Safari: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=200470

(See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.)
